name: Grand Nikko Tokyo Bay Maihama
accessSummary: JR Maihama Station (Keiyo Line / Musashino Line) South Exit: about 7 min by free shuttle bus (Disney Resort Cruiser) / Disney Resort Line: get off at Bayside Station / Metropolitan Expressway Bayshore Route: about 7 min from Kasai Ramp, about 10 min from Urayasu Ramp
hours: Banquet and meeting inquiries are accepted on weekdays 10:00-18:00 (Tel 047-711-2438)

rooms.name: 1F Grand Ballroom (entire)
rooms.note: Can be divided into up to 6 sections. The adjoining banquet lobby "Foyer" is 1,200㎡. The seat counts on the venue's individual page and layout diagram (file updated August 2020) are: theater 1,920 seats, banquet seating of 10 per table x 100 tables = 1,000 seats, classroom 1,224 seats.

rooms.name: 1F Grand Ballroom (1/2)
rooms.note: The seat counts on the venue's individual page and layout diagram are: theater, left 1,080 seats and right 1,020 seats; banquet seating, left 490 seats (49 tables) and right 420 seats (42 tables); classroom, left 660 seats and right 576 seats.

rooms.name: 1F Grand Ballroom (1/3)
rooms.note: The seat counts on the venue's individual page and layout diagram are: theater 612 seats / 680 seats / 612 seats (left / center / right).

rooms.name: 1F ZAZZY
rooms.note: A mid-size banquet room with a wooden floor. The venue's individual page shows round-table banquet seating for 180.

rooms.name: 1F Tilleul
rooms.note: A group lounge. The layout on the venue's individual page is seated for 42.

rooms.name: 1F Olivier
rooms.note: The seat counts on the venue's individual page and layout diagram (file updated August 2020) are: theater 64 seats, classroom 36 seats, enclosed square layout 24 seats, banquet seating of 10 per table x 3 tables = 30 seats.

rooms.name: 1F Acacia
rooms.note: The seat counts on the venue's individual page and layout diagram (file updated August 2020) are: theater 48 seats, classroom 30 seats, enclosed square layout 18 seats, banquet seating of 10 per table x 2 tables = 20 seats.

rooms.name: 2F Rozier / Marronnier
rooms.note: The seat counts on the venue's individual page are: theater 120 seats, classroom 63 seats, banquet seating of 10 per table x 7 tables = 70 seats, seated buffet of 10 per table x 5 tables = 50 seats.

rooms.name: 2F Iris / Erable / Cosmos
rooms.note: Can be divided in two. The layouts on the venue's individual page are: banquet seating of 10 per table x 3 tables = 30 seats, 4 per table x 6 tables = 24 seats, enclosed square layout 24 seats.

rooms.name: 3F La Marée
rooms.note: A seaside banquet room. The layout on the venue's individual page is 7 per table x 11 tables = 77 seats.

rooms.name: 12F La Terrasse
rooms.note: A sky banquet room. For the banquet rooms on the 12F, consult the hotel in advance about use (official guidance).

rooms.name: 12F Palmier
rooms.note: The venue's individual page and layout diagram show banquet seating of 10 per table x 2 tables = 20 people, enclosed square layout for 12. For the banquet rooms on the 12F, consult the hotel in advance about use (official guidance).

rooms.name: 12F Pivoine
rooms.note: The venue's individual page and layout diagram show banquet seating of 6 per table x 3 tables = 18 people, enclosed square layout for 12 (the facility comparison table says 20). For the banquet rooms on the 12F, consult the hotel in advance about use (official guidance).

ops.parking: Banquet guests park free for up to 6 hours, then 300 yen (tax included) per 30 minutes. The regular rate is 300 yen per 30 minutes. No parking ticket is issued on entry; tell the venue you are using for the event that you parked, receive a discount ticket, and pay at a payment machine (3F front desk, 1F main entrance, or 2 machines inside the parking lot). The 4-digit vehicle number must be entered when paying. If the discount procedure is not completed, the regular rate applies.
ops.waitingRooms: On the 1F, the small banquet rooms Olivier (67㎡) and Acacia (54㎡) adjoin the Grand Ballroom and the Foyer, and are described as ideal for use as an event office or waiting room. Iris / Erable / Cosmos (66㎡, divisible in two) on the 2F can also be used as waiting rooms.
ops.restaurants: The restaurants in the hotel are Le Jardin on the 3F (475 seats, all-day dining with buffet and a la carte) and Tamakagari on the 3F (105 seats, with counter seats, table seats and private rooms). For banquets, the hotel offers a small-group dining plan (from 10 people, from 15,000 yen per person, food and 2 hours of room fee included) and a party plan (30 to 80 people, from 9,500 yen per person, 2 hours of free drinks).
